CheckTitle: Diagnostic Logs are enabled for all Monitor categories
Description: Enable diagnostic logging for all categories to ensure comprehensive monitoring and auditing.
Risk: Missing diagnostic logs can impede incident response and troubleshooting.

Code.CLI: az monitor diagnostic-settings subscription create --name <setting-name> --location <location> --workspace <workspace-id> --logs '[{"categoryGroup": "allLogs","enabled": true}]'

Recommendation.Text: Configure diagnostic settings to capture all log categories for your resources.
